checks.finding: REQ-001–012 and AC-001–018 identify the actors, authority, failure behavior and observable outcomes. The 3,000 ms core deadline, separate 5-second native candidate and REQ-010 overflow order are explicit.

AC-010 distinguishes a core timeout warning from a forced-kill host warning; TEST-034 and TEST-035 test them separately. No direct conflict was found among the reviewed requirements and acceptance criteria.
TEST-004–008, TEST-024–035, TEST-041–060 and TEST-063–066 cover unavailable inputs, corruption, failure, time and size boundaries, forced termination and ordered overflow.
Requirements OQ-005–012 assign owners and resolution paths; shared repository state requires rechecking, and installed-host behavior remains explicitly unproven.

The requirements prohibit conversation-derived approval or Done status. AC-009 requires a proven manual barrier; AC-010 and TEST-035 require an observable host warning or mark automatic activation unavailable.
The requirements and planned tests define product behavior and verification surfaces while leaving mechanism and native support evidence to later phases.
The allowed inputs contain no approved, valid domain model to assess.
